directTariff.scope: all Dream Energy stations in France

rule: Until and including 2026-09-30, apply 0.49 EUR/kWh only to EVSE positively identified as direct Dream Energy stations in France. Do not use this tariff for third-party RFID/eMSP pricing, roaming rows, or non-Dream-Energy operators. After 2026-09-30 the promotional rule expires automatically and no tariff may be inferred without a fresh official source. Preserve any separately proven occupancy/overstay fee; do not invent one where the exact amount is not published.
